description: Implementation of common string routines such as strcpy, strncpy, strchr, strrchr, strlen, strcmp, strncmp, strtok_r, strcat, strncat, memcmp, memmove, memcpy, memset, and memchr.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies a string from source to destination.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies a specified number of characters from source to destination.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares a specified number of characters of two strings.

methods.name: strtok_r
methods.description: Tokenizes a string based on separator characters.

methods.name: strncat
methods.description: Concatenates a specified number of characters from one string to another.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies memory areas with overlap handling.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Sets a block of memory to a specific value.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Scans memory for a specific byte.
